name: Semmering Railway
description: The Semmering Railway climbs 41 km through the Alps of eastern Austria, from Gloggnitz to Mürzzuschlag, and is often called the world's first true mountain railway. Built between 1848 and 1854, it loops across stone viaducts and through tunnels above forested valleys. Trains still run on it today, and the resort villas that appeared along the route are part of the view.
